rows.en: It has been a long while. I am counting on you.
Long time no see. I'm counting on you again.
2059, 49 years after mankind's first interstellar war. Macross Frontier, the 25th giant emigrant fleet, sails near the galactic core: an artificial Earth for over 10 million.
rows.notes: seikan sensou heard as Seikan (place name); read as seikan sensou 'interstellar war'. Compressed to fit the 178-byte limit. Fleet number 25th as spoken; the glossary Frontier fleet entry is needs_check over 21st vs 25th.

rows.en: The Macross Galaxy fleet also sailed nearby, and the two fleets kept up exchanges.
Then Sheryl Nome, the diva called the Galactic Fairy, came from Galaxy to Frontier on a live tour. A new threat to humanity began to stir from there.
